text: Implemented on work/claude-w01: trail (NativeGoldenCommandFxSuite: Explain(ParticipantSummary P17 Remembered) gives trail Summary(native spec) > Group(Remembered) > P17, crumbs '... › Remembered › P17'; suite passes 1/1 on a real session) and lookup refusal (RealNavigatorSuite: unserved fixation -> Left(UnboundFixation)). Finding: on native admitted input the MissingSource branches (NoLedger, UnknownTrial, FixationOutOfRange, NotAdmitted) are unreachable, because record() resolves only fixations the navigator served, each with ledger evidence; they guard legacy/evidence-less inputs. The S3.4 AC 'explicit MissingSource' is therefore met as an explicit refusal on real input.
